description.en: Intended to check whether a formation position slot (or all of them, if no index is given) is already filled by a roster character. Never called from any shipped script in script_clean/. Its native implementation does compute a filled-slot count internally, but that count doesn't appear to feed into the traced return value below — treat the exact success semantics with caution.
Optional position index to check; when omitted, all 16 slots are scanned internally.
True on any valid call (the internal filled-slot count doesn't visibly affect the returned value in the decompiled code); null only if the call is made before the engine/script state is ready.

example.code:
// Check a specific formation position slot
local isFull = CMND_IS_FULL_POSITION(3);
